name: ResolveOne Member 3 - LLM Integration Context
purpose: Provide a complete, standalone context for an LLM to implement Member 3 (integration, orchestration, execution, UI) without reading the repository.
workflow: Receive synthetic PAYMENT_EXCEPTION_CREATED event (event includes exception_id and trace_id)
Load canonical Case by exception_id (validate required fields)
Obtain/transport validated AccessContext (from Member 1) — do not mint client-side
Build AuthorizationRequest and call Member 1: authorize_action(request, access_context) => AuthorizationResponse
Persist or reference initial GovernanceReceipt (create_governance_receipt) if not already created
Branch on AuthorizationResponse.decision: ALLOW | DENY | REQUIRE_APPROVAL
If ALLOW: check Member 3 kill-switch state; when enabled and autonomy allowed call retry_payment(request) (sandbox only)
Verify ExecutionResult (verifier) and call Member 1: finalize_governance_receipt(receipt_id, execution_result, ...)
Refresh lineage via Member 1: get_case_lineage(exception_id) and emit UI/metrics/telemetry

investigate_exception.purpose: Return a structured proposed action for a Case; never grant authority

handle_chat.purpose: Support EXPLAIN / QUERY / ACT intents; ACT returns ProposedAction

member3.orchestrator_entry: integration/orchestrator.py (single entrypoint to wire the flow)

constraints: Never call real payment rails; only use sandbox retry_payment
Do not accept role or identity from UI; derive from validated AccessContext only
ProposedAction is advisory only; authorization must be requested from Member 1
Check kill-switch immediately before any execution call
All receipt revisions are handled by Member 1; Member 3 requests create/finalize only

fakes_and_adapters.execution: use local sandbox implementation in execution/ (no external network)

environment_variables.name: GROQ_API_KEY
environment_variables.note: do not include secret in prompts

environment_variables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environment_variables.note: do not include secret in prompts

environment_variables.name: RESOLVEONE_KILL_SWITCH
environment_variables.note: optional override for autonomy in demo

acceptance_criteria: End-to-end Technical Glitch golden scenario: event->investigate->authorize->(ALLOW)->sandbox retry->verify->finalize receipt
Kill switch OFF: execution call count = 0 and receipt outcome = NOT_EXECUTED with AUTONOMY_DISABLED
REQUIRE_APPROVAL produces pending receipt and no execution until approval recorded
DENY produces final receipt with NOT_EXECUTED outcome
Fakes and real adapters are interchangeable without business-logic changes

implementation_tasks.task: implement orchestrator entrypoint that wires event->investigate->authorize->branch
implement kill-switch state store and enforcement in execution/kill_switch.py
implement sandbox retry_payment(request) that returns deterministic SUCCESS/FAILED fixtures
implement verifier to validate ExecutionResult and mark verification
call Member 1 APIs to create and finalize receipts and to fetch lineage for UI
emit telemetry and persist runtime metrics (p50,p95,cost,success)
add integration tests using fakes for ALLOW, DENY, REQUIRE_APPROVAL

notes_for_llm: This JSON is the only input file. Implement pure orchestration, defensive validation, kill-switch enforcement, sandbox execution, receipt lifecycle calls to Member 1, and preserve all cited IDs and evidence. Do not embed secrets or call any external payment rails.
